steps.title: Plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as mooring_eye.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane: a 90 wide plate 54 high with a round end radius 45. Extrude 20 mm, Symmetric.
steps.note: The origin is the top of the plate, on the weld.

steps.title: Pin hole
actions: Hole diameter 30 Through All on the centre of the round end. Save.
steps.note: The 28 diameter load pin fits with 2 mm clearance.
